oncall-bot: P1 alert — KV-cache tp-shard pool 'tp-3' reporting sustained memory growth + repeated NCCL stall traces on GPUs gpux-07..09. Autoscaler paused automatically. Triggering incident channel.
Maria: I'm taking first look, pulling logs and kv metrics. Seeing continuous_batching tokens spike around 17:40 UTC.
Devon: Runtime here — last runtime rollout included batching window tweak (commit a1b2c3). Suspect batching window -> unbounded prefix cache when shard sizes skew. Pulling partition stats.
Jess: Marking customer impact; latency 95th jumped to 6-10s for kv routes, error spikes on some backends.
Sam: PM: Notifying top customers now (AcmeCorp, Skyline, EduServe). They're seeing slow responses but not total outages. I'll track support tickets.
Devon: Mitigation plan (short): 1) disable continuous batching for kv routes globally 2) force reshard to rebalance partitions 3) restart NCCL daemons / pods if stalls persist. I'll apply config change now.
Devon: ```bash
# disable continuous batching for kv route
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/configs/routes/kv/overrides" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"overrides":{"continuous_batching":false,"batch_min_tokens":0}}'

# trigger reshard job (internal tooling)
kubectl -n inference exec job/kv-reshard -- /bin/sh -c "python reshard.py --target-even --reason 'incident 1745032100'"
```
deploy-bot: config-change applied to route kv by Devon at 1745032205, change-id cfg-6743. Rolling update started across 12 clusters (canary first).
Maria: Observing immediate improvement — memory growth on gpux-07..09 flattens within ~60-90s. NCCL error rate dropped from ~12/min -> ~0.
Jess: Scheduling rolling restarts for affected pods to clear any remaining NCCL state. 5 min delay between pod restarts to avoid spike.
Sam: Customer impact summary: AcmeCorp ~6% of requests timed out or errored during peak window, Skyline reporting mainly latency. Support ticket INC-1543 opened for AcmeCorp.
Devon: After disabling batching, 95th latency for kv route fell from 4.8s -> 0.9s. Throughput reduced ~7% but stable. Preparing a correctness hotfix for batching calc so we can safely re-enable. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/892 
Maria: Handing off monitoring to Jess for the overnight shift. I'm creating a temporary dashboard with NCCL backlog, shard-size skew, kv-cache-memory, and continuous_batching queue depth.
Jess: Taking over on-call. Runbook notes added: 1) watch NCCL_BACKLOG and NCCL_ERRORS 2) if stalls reappear, set env NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 on affected pods 3) escalate to Runtime (Devon) if stalls persist after restart.
Devon: Root cause hypothesis: commit a1b2c3 changed shard hashing boundary and introduced uneven partition sizes; continuous batching aggregated large prefixes into single cache entries which caused local cache blowups on heavy shards and triggered NCCL partial sync stalls. We'll add unit tests for reshard validation and a guard that rejects continuous_batching when skew > 2x.
deploy-bot: Hotfix cfg-6743 confirmed rolled out (continuous_batching=false) across production clusters at 1745032350.
Maria: Postmortem TODOs: impact window 1745032100-1745032400; list affected customers + ticket numbers; follow-ups: strict reshard validation, batch-size early-abort > X tokens, KV eviction tuning, resharding telemetry.
Sam: I'll draft a customer-facing post (short incident summary + mitigations) and coordinate CS replies. ETA for final fix: next-week release; hotfix re-enable gated by integration tests.
Jess: Hand-off complete. If any regressions overnight ping @Devon and @Jess directly. Adding :thumbsup: reaction and closing active ack.
deploy-bot: Incident INC-1543 created and linked to this channel. Recorded timeline and config-change cfg-6743.
